terms.definition: Binding generated claims to retrieved external evidence with explicit provenance.
A bounded normalized set of sources and claim-support material passed to a model.
The execution environment whose successful checks permit a phase to merge.
An opaque reference issued by MAX Grounding for evidence it retrieved and validated; callers cannot set or mutate the source, chunk, excerpt, or score represented by the reference.
A citation identity and exact evidence excerpt constructed by MAX Grounding from its server-owned evidence record, not from model-generated source markers.
A structured response separating all verifications, synthesis-safe SUPPORTED claims, blocked claims, and canonical citations.
